subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Firend** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Firend:** a person that you know and like and who likes you. (एक व्यक्ति जिसे आप जानते हैं और पसंद करते हैं और जो आपको पसंद करता है) • Example - *Seema and I are old **friends**. We were at school together.* Therefore, except for **option 2**, the rest of the options are correctly spelt. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Freeze **means to become hard and often change into ice because of extreme cold. (अत्यधिक ठंड के कारण कठोर हो जाना और अक्सर बर्फ में बदल जाना) • **Frigid **means very cold in temperature. (तापमान में बहुत ठंडा) • **Fright **means a sudden feeling of fear or shock. (डर या सदमे की अचानक भावना) 1fe:Tc68, The correct answer is **"masterpiece"**
